checks.name: award_amount_is_not_period_obligation
checks.detail: Award-search totals include full value of contracts signed in earlier years; they must never be used as period dollars.

checks.name: recipient_rows_reconcile_to_series
checks.detail: Top-100 recipients should account for ~all obligations in window; a large gap means the long tail is being dropped from the denominator.

checks.name: parent_rollup_changed_the_answer
checks.detail: Rolling child entities to owner groups must raise the leader's share; if it does not, parent resolution silently failed.

checks.name: no_duplicate_owner_groups
checks.detail: Each owner group appears exactly once in the concentration chart.

checks.name: primary_lens_is_not_propulsion
checks.detail: Guards the framing: propulsion product codes are a rounding error inside NAICS 336415, so its dollars must never be described as propulsion spending. If this share ever rises above 5%, the wording on the site and in the analysis has to be revisited.

checks.name: single_award_obligations_fit_inside_the_year
checks.detail: A single award's per-year obligations must never exceed the category total for that year. If they do, award-level and category-level figures are being mixed.

checks.name: concentration_survives_removing_the_largest_award
checks.detail: The concentration finding must not rest on a single contract. If removing the largest award drops HHI below the highly-concentrated threshold, the headline claim needs rewriting, not just a footnote.

checks.name: motor_concentration_predates_the_acquisition
checks.detail: Guards the ownership rollup against the charge that a 2023 merger retroactively manufactured the single-source finding. If the pre-acquisition leader ever falls below 50%, the claim has to be restated as a post-merger effect.

checks.name: negative_obligations_are_floored_not_netted
checks.detail: Deobligations can push a recipient net-negative over a window. Shares use the positive-obligation denominator so that no share exceeds 100% and HHI stays well defined.

checks.name: subawards_deduped
checks.detail: Raw subaward responses repeat rows across contract modifications.
